_meta.purpose: TEMPLATE. Your laboratory results as a time series per marker. PERSONAL — you fill it in yourself; do not pass it to anyone.
_meta.how_to_fill: Easiest: put the lab's PDF reports in one folder and run `scholion ingest-labs "<folder>"` (or use the «Labs» tab in the application). By hand: add points to markers[key].series.
_meta.shape: markers: { <key>: { name, unit, ref_low?, ref_high?, direction?('higher_better'|'lower_better'), genome_link?, series: [{date:'YYYY-MM'|'YYYY-MM-DD', value:number}] } }
_meta.why_empty: This file ships EMPTY on purpose. A sample measurement left in here would be counted, flagged and shown as if it were yours — a statement about a person made from a template. The example above is a string, so nothing reads it as data.
